problem_restatement.objective: Identify one liquid, source-defined non-crypto market that can add a materially distinct opportunity stream without blindly transferring an existing strategy.
success_criteria: current public liquidity sufficient for bounded research
continuous point-in-time source coverage for an initial dependence screen
materially distinct return behavior from the existing SP500 and SPCX research universe
no live authority inferred from market liquidity or correlation

instrument_identity.description: Modified-capitalization-weighted index of 100 large non-financial U.S.-listed companies with growth-sector concentration.
instrument_identity.oracle_summary: Cash-session spot index pricing with futures-derived implied-spot pricing outside the cash session during external coverage.
instrument_identity.external_coverage: Sunday 18:00 ET through Friday 17:00 ET with daily 17:00-18:00 ET gaps and exchange holiday closures.

qualification_blockers: full venue-matched chronological source exceeds the public candle cap
exact strategy and both-side economics are untested
margin-table details were unavailable in the public qualification response
execution and TUI integration were not evaluated

dependence_test.interpretation: XYZ100 is persistently coupled to SP500 in this point-in-time market-return sample. It does not satisfy the requested independent-opportunity role even though it may be tradable under a distinct future mechanism.

decision.reason: The high and fold-stable SP500 correlation contradicts the independence objective, while no XYZ100-native strategy evidence exists.

remaining_blockers: archive public-trade OHLC versus live candleSnapshot parity remains unverified
archive websocket L2 versus live REST pressure-decision parity remains unresolved
the cumulative eligible decision sample has not been converted into fully resolved exact-contract lifecycles
one prior profitable short is entirely largest-winner dependent and has no exact long counterpart

single_highest_value_next_investigation.action: Freeze the current SP500 v3 decision, book, candle, mark, fee, and funding prefixes at one declared cutoff and resolve the eligible long and short paths under the unchanged v51 80-bps stop, 100/40/80 profit-lock, opposite-intent, and 24-hour fallback contract.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.why_now: The route already has source-native both-side eligible events and ongoing raw capture; lifecycle resolution closes a narrower and more decision-relevant evidence gap than adding another correlated index or retuning entry thresholds.
minimum_output: resolved versus censored lifecycle count by side
fees, funding, slippage, stop, profit-lock, opposite-intent, and max-hold attribution
net, profit factor, drawdown, and largest-winner sensitivity
explicit unresolved-path causes without midpoint or oracle substitution
single_highest_value_next_investigation.success_condition: At least one technically resolved long and additional independent short outcomes become available without route or parameter changes.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.failure_condition: Exact-source gaps, source revisions, unresolved mark paths, or identity mismatch prevent causal lifecycle resolution.

alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Adds liquidity but duplicates SP500 factor exposure and has no route economics.

alternatives_considered.option: Transfer SP500 pressure or SPCX cash-open logic to XYZ100
alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Fast to implement but violates source-native validation and ignores XYZ100 oracle/session construction.

alternatives_considered.option: Continue SP500 raw collection without lifecycle resolution
alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Preserves data but delays the evidence needed for an economic decision.

alternatives_considered.option: Resolve the already-captured SP500 v3 lifecycles
alternatives_considered.tradeoff: No live downside and highest information value, but exact path gaps may censor the result.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: Market-return correlation is not strategy-return correlation and can change by regime.
The 53-day sample may underrepresent tail dependence and structural breaks.
Public candleSnapshot OHLC can differ from public-trade OHLC used by archive research.
A distinct XYZ100-native strategy could later reduce signal overlap despite high market correlation.
SP500 lifecycle resolution can remain technically censored if exact marks or quotes are incomplete.
falsifier: Reopen XYZ100 as an independent candidate only if a preregistered XYZ100-native mechanism produces source-complete strategy returns with materially lower SP500/SPCX signal and PnL dependence, realistic exact costs, chronological stability, and positive largest-winner-removed evidence. Update the SP500 priority if its frozen lifecycle paths cannot be resolved or resolve adversely after exact costs.

evidence.role: current official public xyz liquidity ranking
append-only report-only SP500 decision-ledger prefix at the declared observation
prior exact single-short SP500 lifecycle disposition
prior portfolio opportunity and candidate disposition
